description: This file defines a Java class CpuUsageParser that reads and parses CPU usage information from lines of text, specifically extracting data related to CPU usage intervals and total usage metrics from a bug report. It uses regex patterns to identify relevant lines and constructs a CpuUsageSnapshot object with the parsed data.

classes.name: CpuUsageParser
classes.description: A parser class that reads lines of CPU usage report and extracts relevant CPU usage metrics into a CpuUsageSnapshot object.

methods.name: CpuUsageParser
methods.description: Constructor for CpuUsageParser. No special initialization.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses lines of text to extract CPU usage data based on regex patterns, returning a CpuUsageSnapshot object with the retrieved metrics.
